rules.title: Missing version
rules.detail: Both marketing version and build number are required.

rules.title: No privacy manifest found
rules.detail: Review whether the app or embedded SDKs require PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy.

rules.title: Executable could not be inspected
rules.detail: Verify CFBundleExecutable and the Mach-O binary inside the app bundle.

rules.title: Simulator architecture included
rules.detail: App Store IPA files should not contain i386 or x86_64 executable slices.

rules.title: Provisioning profile not found
rules.detail: App Store distributions may omit embedded.mobileprovision; development and ad hoc builds normally include it.

rules.title: Weak privacy explanation
rules.detail_suffix: should clearly explain why the data or capability is needed.
